Partner With Us

Good work grows through shared effort.

Aashray welcomes conversations with organisations and individuals who want to contribute practical support to community initiatives.

01 / Partner With Us

Areas for collaboration

Education and digital learning; community relief; health and wellbeing; volunteer participation; resource support; future women and livelihood initiatives; planned environment, animal welfare and rights awareness work.

The scope of a partnership will depend on the program stage, community needs and the responsibilities agreed by both teams.

02 / Partner With Us

Who can connect

Local businesses, schools and colleges, health institutions, trainers, community groups, NGOs and professionals can discuss ways to work with us. Your expertise, resources or local understanding may help shape an appropriate collaboration.

03 / Partner With Us

Start with a conversation

Tell us about your organisation, your area of interest and the contribution you have in mind. We can discuss fit, program readiness and the next steps before making commitments.
